Кто связывает крепче

Вы узнаете

Какой из двух операторов делит выражение и почему самые крепкие операторы группируются раньше.

Парсер читает выражение через 11 функций, и каждая вызывает следующую, более крепкую, для своих операндов: or, and, сравнение, битовое или, битовое исключающее или, битовое и, сдвиг, сложение, умножение, унарные и постфиксные. Поэтому самые крепкие операторы группируются раньше. binds_looser(a, b) сравнивает два уровня, а сетка рисует все 121 ответ: сложение связывает слабее умножения, поэтому в a + b * c группируется произведение. max_children возвращает 32 — столько детей может держать один узел дерева.

Попробовать

Выберите сложение и умножение и прочитайте скобки. Потом выберите сдвиг и сложение: какой оператор делит выражение?

Открыть интерактивный урок →

The t27 parser reads an expression through eleven nested levels, from or down to postfix. Pick two operators and binds_looser says which one splits the expression first.

specs/compiler/parser.t27

// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
// specs/compiler/parser.t27
// T27 Parser Specification — Self-hosting compiler core
// φ² + 1/φ² = 3 | TRINITY
//
// This module defines the complete recursive descent parser for the T27 language.
// It is a 1:1 port of bootstrap/src/compiler.rs Parser to t27 spec format.

module Parsing {
    use base::types;
    use compiler::lexer;

    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // 1. AST Node Types
    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    const MAX_CHILDREN: u32 = 32;

    enum NodeKind {
        Module = 0,
        UseDecl = 1,
        ConstDecl = 2,
        VarDecl = 3,
        FnDecl = 4,
        EnumDecl = 5,
        StructDecl = 6,
        TestBlock = 7,
        InvariantBlock = 8,
        BenchBlock = 9,

        StmtLocal = 10,
        StmtAssign = 11,
        StmtIf = 12,
        StmtWhile = 13,
        StmtFor = 14,
        StmtExpr = 15,
        StmtReturn = 16,
        StmtBreak = 17,
        StmtContinue = 18,

        ExprLiteral = 20,
        ExprIdentifier = 21,
        ExprBinary = 22,
        ExprUnary = 23,
        ExprCall = 24,
        ExprFieldAccess = 25,
        ExprIndex = 26,
        ExprSwitch = 27,
        ExprIf = 28,
        ExprStructLit = 29,
        ExprEnumValue = 30,
        ExprReturn = 31,
        ExprArrayLiteral = 32,
    }

    struct Node {
        kind: NodeKind;
        name: str;
        value: str;
        extra_type: str;
        extra_field: str;
        extra_size: str;
        extra_kind: str;
        extra_op: str;
        extra_pub: bool;
        extra_mutable: bool;
        extra_return_type: str;
        child_count: u32;
        children: [MAX_CHILDREN]Node;
    }

    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // 2. Parser State
    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    struct Parser {
        lexer: lexer::Lexer;
        current: lexer::Token;
        peek: lexer::Token;
        had_error: bool;
        error_msg: str;
    }

    fn parser_init(lex: lexer::Lexer) -> Parser {
        var p = Parser{
            lexer = lex,
            current = lexer::make_token_simple(lexer::TokenKind::Eof, 1, 1, "", 0),
            peek = lexer::make_token_simple(lexer::TokenKind::Eof, 1, 1, "", 0),
            had_error = false,
            error_msg = "",
        };
        parser_advance(&p);
        parser_advance(&p);
        return p;
    }

    // parser_from_text(s) -> Parser: copies the bytes of s into the fixed lexer source buffer
    // and primes the parser on it, so a test can start from a plain string.
    fn parser_from_text(s: str) -> Parser {
        var buf: [65536]u8 = [0; 65536];
        var i: u32 = 0;
        while (i < s.len) {
            buf[i] = s[i];
            i = i + 1;
        }
        return parser_init(lexer::lexer_init(buf, s.len as u32));
    }

    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // 3. Movement Primitives
    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    fn parser_advance(self: *Parser) -> void {
        self.current = self.peek;
        const r = lexer::next_token(self.lexer);
        self.lexer = r.0;
        self.peek = r.1;
    }

    fn check(self: *Parser, kind: lexer::TokenKind) -> bool {
        return self.current.kind == kind;
    }

    fn check_peek(self: *Parser, kind: lexer::TokenKind) -> bool {
        return self.peek.kind == kind;
    }

    fn expect(self: *Parser, kind: lexer::TokenKind) -> bool {
        if (self.check(kind)) {
            parser_advance(self);
            return true;
        }
        self.had_error = true;
        self.error_msg = "Expected token";
        return false;
    }

    fn report_error(self: *Parser, msg: str) -> void {
        self.had_error = true;
        self.error_msg = msg;
    }

    fn get_error(self: Parser) -> str {
        return self.error_msg;
    }

    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // 4. Error Recovery
    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    fn skip_brace_body(self: *Parser) -> bool {
        var depth: i32 = 1;
        while (depth > 0) {
            if (self.current.kind == lexer::TokenKind::Eof) {
                self.report_error("Unexpected EOF inside brace body");
                return false;
            }
            if (self.current.kind == lexer::TokenKind::LBrace) {
                depth = depth + 1;
            } else if (self.current.kind == lexer::TokenKind::RBrace) {
                depth = depth - 1;
                if (depth == 0) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
            parser_advance(self);
        }
        return true;
    }

    fn skip_to_semicolon(self: *Parser) -> void {
        var bracket_depth: i32 = 0;
        var paren_depth: i32 = 0;
        while (self.current.kind != lexer::TokenKind::Eof) {
            if (self.current.kind == lexer::TokenKind::Semicolon 
                and bracket_depth == 0 
                and paren_depth == 0) {
                parser_advance(self);
                return;
            }
            if (self.current.kind == lexer::TokenKind::LBrace) {
                parser_advance(self);
                self.skip_brace_body();
                if (self.current.kind == lexer::TokenKind::RBrace) {
                    parser_advance(self);
                }
            } else if (self.current.kind == lexer::TokenKind::LBracket) {
                bracket_depth = bracket_depth + 1;
                parser_advance(self);
            } else if (self.current.kind == lexer::TokenKind::RBracket) {
                bracket_depth = bracket_depth - 1;
                parser_advance(self);
            } else if (self.current.kind == lexer::TokenKind::LParen) {
                paren_depth = paren_depth + 1;
                parser_advance(self);
            } else if (self.current.kind == lexer::TokenKind::RParen) {
                paren_depth = paren_depth - 1;
                parser_advance(self);
            } else {
                parser_advance(self);
            }
        }
    }

    fn is_top_level_start(self: Parser) -> bool {
        return self.current.kind == lexer::TokenKind::KwPub
            or self.current.kind == lexer::TokenKind::KwFn
            or self.current.kind == lexer::TokenKind::KwEnum
            or self.current.kind == lexer::TokenKind::KwStruct
            or self.current.kind == lexer::TokenKind::KwTest
            or self.current.kind == lexer::TokenKind::KwInvariant
            or self.current.kind == lexer::TokenKind::KwBench
            or self.current.kind == lexer::TokenKind::KwUse
            or self.current.kind == lexer::TokenKind::KwUsing
            or self.current.kind == lexer::TokenKind::KwModule
            or self.current.kind == lexer::TokenKind::RBrace
            or self.current.kind == lexer::TokenKind::Eof;
    }

    fn skip_to_next_top_level(self: *Parser) -> void {
        var paren_depth: i32 = 0;
        var bracket_depth: i32 = 0;
        while (true) {
            if (self.current.kind == lexer::TokenKind::Eof) {
                break;
            }
            if (self.current.kind == lexer::TokenKind::LBrace) {
                parser_advance(self);
                self.skip_brace_body();
                if (self.current.kind == lexer::TokenKind::RBrace) {
                    parser_advance(self);
                }
            }
            if (self.current.kind == lexer::TokenKind::LParen) {
                paren_depth = paren_depth + 1;
                parser_advance(self);
            }
            if (self.current.kind == lexer::TokenKind::RParen) {
                paren_depth = paren_depth - 1;
                parser_advance(self);
            }
            if (self.current.kind == lexer::TokenKind::LBracket) {
                bracket_depth = bracket_depth + 1;
                parser_advance(self);
            }
            if (self.current.kind == lexer::TokenKind::RBracket) {
                bracket_depth = bracket_depth - 1;
                parser_advance(self);
            }
            if (paren_depth == 0 and bracket_depth == 0 and self.is_top_level_start()) {
                break;
            }
            parser_advance(self);
        }
    }

    fn recover_to_stmt_boundary(self: *Parser) -> void {
        var brace_depth: i32 = 0;
        while (true) {
            if (self.current.kind == lexer::TokenKind::Eof) {
                break;
            }
            if (self.current.kind == lexer::TokenKind::Semicolon and brace_depth == 0) {
                parser_advance(self);
                break;
            }
            if (self.current.kind == lexer::TokenKind::RBrace and brace_depth == 0) {
                break;
            }
            if (self.current.kind == lexer::TokenKind::LBrace) {
                brace_depth = brace_depth + 1;
                parser_advance(self);
            } else if (self.current.kind == lexer::TokenKind::RBrace) {
                brace_depth = brace_depth - 1;
                parser_advance(self);
            } else {
                parser_advance(self);
            }
        }
    }

    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // 5. Type Annotation Parser
    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    fn parse_type_annotation(self: *Parser) -> str {
        var ty: str = "";

        if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Star)) {
            parser_advance(self);
            ty = ty ++ "*";
            if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::KwConst)) {
                parser_advance(self);
                ty = ty ++ "const ";
            }
            if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Ident)) {
                ty = ty ++ self.current.lexeme;
                parser_advance(self);
            }
            return ty;
        }

        while (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::LBracket)) {
            parser_advance(self);
            ty = ty ++ "[";
            while (self.current.kind != lexer::TokenKind::RBracket 
                   and self.current.kind != lexer::TokenKind::Eof) {
                ty = ty ++ self.current.lexeme;
                parser_advance(self);
            }
            ty = ty ++ "]";
            if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::RBracket)) {
                parser_advance(self);
            }
        }

        if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::KwConst)) {
            if (ty != "") {
                ty = ty ++ "const ";
            } else {
                ty = "const ";
            }
            parser_advance(self);
        }

        if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Star)) {
            parser_advance(self);
            ty = ty ++ "*";
            if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::KwConst)) {
                parser_advance(self);
                ty = ty ++ "const ";
            }
        }

        if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Ident)) {
            ty = ty ++ self.current.lexeme;
            parser_advance(self);
        } else if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::KwVoid)) {
            ty = ty ++ "void";
            parser_advance(self);
        }

        return ty;
    }

    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // 6. Expression Parser (Precedence Levels)
    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    fn node_new(kind: NodeKind) -> Node {
        return Node{
            kind = kind,
            name = "",
            value = "",
            extra_type = "",
            extra_field = "",
            extra_size = "",
            extra_kind = "",
            extra_op = "",
            extra_pub = false,
            extra_mutable = false,
            extra_return_type = "",
            child_count = 0,
            children = [Node{}; MAX_CHILDREN],
        };
    }

    fn add_child(parent: *Node, child: Node) -> void {
        if (parent.child_count < MAX_CHILDREN) {
            parent.children[parent.child_count] = child;
            parent.child_count = parent.child_count + 1;
        }
    }

    fn parse_expr(self: *Parser) -> Node {
        return self.parse_expr_or();
    }

    fn parse_expr_or(self: *Parser) -> Node {
        var left = self.parse_expr_and();
        while (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::KwOr)) {
            parser_advance(self);
            const right = self.parse_expr_and();
            var node = node_new(NodeKind::ExprBinary);
            node.extra_op = "or";
            add_child(&node, left);
            add_child(&node, right);
            left = node;
        }
        return left;
    }

    fn parse_expr_and(self: *Parser) -> Node {
        var left = self.parse_expr_comparison();
        while (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::KwAnd)) {
            parser_advance(self);
            const right = self.parse_expr_comparison();
            var node = node_new(NodeKind::ExprBinary);
            node.extra_op = "and";
            add_child(&node, left);
            add_child(&node, right);
            left = node;
        }
        return left;
    }

    fn parse_expr_comparison(self: *Parser) -> Node {
        var left = self.parse_expr_bitor();
        while (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Eq)
               or self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Neq)
               or self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Lt)
               or self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Gt)
               or self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Lte)
               or self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Gte)
               or self.check(lexer::TokenKind::DotDot)) {
            const op = self.current.lexeme;
            parser_advance(self);
            const right = self.parse_expr_bitor();
            var node = node_new(NodeKind::ExprBinary);
            node.extra_op = op;
            add_child(&node, left);
            add_child(&node, right);
            left = node;
        }
        return left;
    }

    fn parse_expr_bitor(self: *Parser) -> Node {
        var left = self.parse_expr_bitxor();
        while (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Pipe)) {
            const op = self.current.lexeme;
            parser_advance(self);
            const right = self.parse_expr_bitxor();
            var node = node_new(NodeKind::ExprBinary);
            node.extra_op = op;
            add_child(&node, left);
            add_child(&node, right);
            left = node;
        }
        return left;
    }

    fn parse_expr_bitxor(self: *Parser) -> Node {
        var left = self.parse_expr_bitand();
        while (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Caret)) {
            const op = self.current.lexeme;
            parser_advance(self);
            const right = self.parse_expr_bitand();
            var node = node_new(NodeKind::ExprBinary);
            node.extra_op = op;
            add_child(&node, left);
            add_child(&node, right);
            left = node;
        }
        return left;
    }

    fn parse_expr_bitand(self: *Parser) -> Node {
        var left = self.parse_expr_shift();
        while (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Amp)) {
            const op = self.current.lexeme;
            parser_advance(self);
            const right = self.parse_expr_shift();
            var node = node_new(NodeKind::ExprBinary);
            node.extra_op = op;
            add_child(&node, left);
            add_child(&node, right);
            left = node;
        }
        return left;
    }

    fn parse_expr_shift(self: *Parser) -> Node {
        var left = self.parse_expr_additive();
        while (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::ShiftLeft) or self.check(lexer::TokenKind::ShiftRight)) {
            const op = self.current.lexeme;
            parser_advance(self);
            const right = self.parse_expr_additive();
            var node = node_new(NodeKind::ExprBinary);
            node.extra_op = op;
            add_child(&node, left);
            add_child(&node, right);
            left = node;
        }
        return left;
    }

    fn parse_expr_additive(self: *Parser) -> Node {
        var left = self.parse_expr_multiplicative();
        while (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Plus) 
               or self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Minus) 
               or self.check(lexer::TokenKind::PlusPercent)) {
            const op = self.current.lexeme;
            parser_advance(self);
            const right = self.parse_expr_multiplicative();
            var node = node_new(NodeKind::ExprBinary);
            node.extra_op = op;
            add_child(&node, left);
            add_child(&node, right);
            left = node;
        }
        return left;
    }

    fn parse_expr_multiplicative(self: *Parser) -> Node {
        var left = self.parse_expr_unary();
        while (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Star) 
               or self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Slash) 
               or self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Percent) 
               or self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Power)) {
            const op = self.current.lexeme;
            parser_advance(self);
            const right = self.parse_expr_unary();
            var node = node_new(NodeKind::ExprBinary);
            node.extra_op = op;
            add_child(&node, left);
            add_child(&node, right);
            left = node;
        }
        return left;
    }

    fn parse_expr_unary(self: *Parser) -> Node {
        if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Minus) 
            or self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Bang) 
            or self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Tilde) 
            or self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Amp)) {
            const op = self.current.lexeme;
            parser_advance(self);
            const operand = self.parse_expr_unary();
            var node = node_new(NodeKind::ExprUnary);
            node.extra_op = op;
            add_child(&node, operand);
            return node;
        }
        return self.parse_expr_postfix();
    }

    fn parse_expr_postfix(self: *Parser) -> Node {
        var expr = self.parse_expr_primary();

        while (true) {
            if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Dot)) {
                parser_advance(self);
                if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Star)) {
                    parser_advance(self);
                    var deref = node_new(NodeKind::ExprFieldAccess);
                    deref.name = "*";
                    add_child(&deref, expr);
                    expr = deref;
                } else if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Ident)) {
                    const field = self.current.lexeme;
                    parser_advance(self);
                    if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::LParen)) {
                        expr = self.parse_call_args_internal(field, expr);
                    } else {
                        var fa = node_new(NodeKind::ExprFieldAccess);
                        fa.name = field;
                        add_child(&fa, expr);
                        expr = fa;
                    }
                } else {
                    break;
                }
            } else if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::LBracket)) {
                parser_advance(self);
                const index = self.parse_expr();
                self.expect(lexer::TokenKind::RBracket);
                var idx_node = node_new(NodeKind::ExprIndex);
                add_child(&idx_node, expr);
                add_child(&idx_node, index);
                expr = idx_node;
            } else if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::LParen)) {
                break;
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }
        return expr;
    }

    fn parse_call_args_internal(self: *Parser, name: str, base_expr: Node) -> Node {
        parser_advance(self);
        var call = node_new(NodeKind::ExprCall);
        call.name = name;
        add_child(&call, base_expr);

        while (self.current.kind != lexer::TokenKind::RParen 
               and self.current.kind != lexer::TokenKind::Eof) {
            const arg = self.parse_expr();
            add_child(&call, arg);
            if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Comma)) {
                parser_advance(self);
            }
        }
        self.expect(lexer::TokenKind::RParen);
        return call;
    }

    fn parse_expr_primary(self: *Parser) -> Node {
        if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Number)) {
            var node = node_new(NodeKind::ExprLiteral);
            node.value = self.current.lexeme;
            parser_advance(self);
            return node;
        }

        if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::CharLiteral)) {
            var node = node_new(NodeKind::ExprLiteral);
            node.value = self.current.lexeme;
            parser_advance(self);
            return node;
        }

        if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::StringLit)) {
            var node = node_new(NodeKind::ExprLiteral);
            node.value = self.current.lexeme;
            parser_advance(self);
            return node;
        }

        if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::KwTrue) or self.check(lexer::TokenKind::KwFalse)) {
            var node = node_new(NodeKind::ExprLiteral);
            node.value = self.current.lexeme;
            parser_advance(self);
            return node;
        }

        if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Dot)) {
            parser_advance(self);
            if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Ident)) {
                var node = node_new(NodeKind::ExprEnumValue);
                node.name = self.current.lexeme;
                parser_advance(self);
                return node;
            }
            return node_new(NodeKind::ExprLiteral);
        }

        if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Ident)) {
            const name = self.current.lexeme;
            parser_advance(self);
            if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::LBrace)) {
                return self.parse_struct_literal(name);
            }
            if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::LParen)) {
                return self.parse_call_args(name);
            }
            var node = node_new(NodeKind::ExprIdentifier);
            node.name = name;
            return node;
        }

        if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::LParen)) {
            parser_advance(self);
            const inner = self.parse_expr();
            self.expect(lexer::TokenKind::RParen);
            return inner;
        }

        if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::KwIf)) {
            return self.parse_if_expr();
        }

        if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::KwSwitch)) {
            return self.parse_switch_expr();
        }

        if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::KwTry)) {
            parser_advance(self);
            const inner = self.parse_expr_postfix();
            var node = node_new(NodeKind::ExprUnary);
            node.extra_op = "try ";
            add_child(&node, inner);
            return node;
        }

        if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::LBracket)) {
            return self.parse_array_literal();
        }

        return node_new(NodeKind::ExprLiteral);
    }

    fn parse_call_args(self: *Parser, name: str) -> Node {
        parser_advance(self);
        var call = node_new(NodeKind::ExprCall);
        call.name = name;

        while (self.current.kind != lexer::TokenKind::RParen 
               and self.current.kind != lexer::TokenKind::Eof) {
            const arg = self.parse_expr();
            add_child(&call, arg);
            if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Comma)) {
                parser_advance(self);
            }
        }
        self.expect(lexer::TokenKind::RParen);
        return call;
    }

    fn parse_struct_literal(self: *Parser, name: str) -> Node {
        parser_advance(self);
        var lit = node_new(NodeKind::ExprStructLit);
        lit.name = name;

        while (self.current.kind != lexer::TokenKind::RBrace 
               and self.current.kind != lexer::TokenKind::Eof) {
            var field_name = "";
            if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Dot)) {
                parser_advance(self);
                if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Ident)) {
                    field_name = self.current.lexeme;
                    parser_advance(self);
                }
            } else if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Ident)) {
                field_name = self.current.lexeme;
                parser_advance(self);
            }

            if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Equals)) {
                parser_advance(self);
            }

            const val = self.parse_expr();
            var field = node_new(NodeKind::ExprFieldAccess);
            field.name = field_name;
            add_child(&field, val);
            add_child(&lit, field);

            if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Comma)) {
                parser_advance(self);
            }
        }
        self.expect(lexer::TokenKind::RBrace);
        return lit;
    }

    fn parse_array_literal(self: *Parser) -> Node {
        var node = node_new(NodeKind::ExprArrayLiteral);
        parser_advance(self);

        if (self.current.kind == lexer::TokenKind::RBracket) {
            parser_advance(self);
        } else {
            var bracket_text = "";
            while (self.current.kind != lexer::TokenKind::RBracket
                   and self.current.kind != lexer::TokenKind::Eof) {
                bracket_text = bracket_text ++ self.current.lexeme;
                parser_advance(self);
            }
            node.extra_size = bracket_text;
            self.expect(lexer::TokenKind::RBracket);
        }

        if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Ident)) {
            node.extra_type = self.current.lexeme;
            parser_advance(self);
        }

        if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::LBrace)) {
            parser_advance(self);
            if (self.current.kind != lexer::TokenKind::RBrace) {
                var elem = self.parse_expr();
                add_child(&node, elem);
                while (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Comma)) {
                    parser_advance(self);
                    if (self.current.kind == lexer::TokenKind::RBrace) {
                        break;
                    }
                    elem = self.parse_expr();
                    add_child(&node, elem);
                }
            }
            self.expect(lexer::TokenKind::RBrace);
        }

        if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Power)) {
            parser_advance(self);
            var count = self.parse_expr();
            var repeat_node = node_new(NodeKind::ExprBinary);
            repeat_node.extra_op = "**";
            add_child(&repeat_node, node);
            add_child(&repeat_node, count);
            return repeat_node;
        }

        return node;
    }

    fn parse_if_expr(self: *Parser) -> Node {
        parser_advance(self);
        var node = node_new(NodeKind::ExprIf);

        self.expect(lexer::TokenKind::LParen);
        const cond = self.parse_expr();
        self.expect(lexer::TokenKind::RParen);
        add_child(&node, cond);

        const then_expr = self.parse_expr();
        add_child(&node, then_expr);

        if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::KwElse)) {
            parser_advance(self);
            const else_expr = self.parse_expr();
            add_child(&node, else_expr);
        }

        return node;
    }

    fn parse_switch_expr(self: *Parser) -> Node {
        parser_advance(self);
        var sw = node_new(NodeKind::ExprSwitch);

        self.expect(lexer::TokenKind::LParen);
        const val = self.parse_expr();
        self.expect(lexer::TokenKind::RParen);
        add_child(&sw, val);

        self.expect(lexer::TokenKind::LBrace);

        while (self.current.kind != lexer::TokenKind::RBrace 
               and self.current.kind != lexer::TokenKind::Eof) {
            var arm = node_new(NodeKind::ConstDecl);

            if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Dot)) {
                parser_advance(self);
                if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Ident)) {
                    arm.name = self.current.lexeme;
                    parser_advance(self);
                }
            } else if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::KwElse)) {
                arm.name = "else";
                parser_advance(self);
            } else if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Minus)) {
                arm.name = "-";
                parser_advance(self);
                if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Number)) {
                    arm.name = arm.name ++ self.current.lexeme;
                    parser_advance(self);
                }
            } else if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Ident) or self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Number)) {
                arm.name = self.current.lexeme;
                parser_advance(self);
            }

            if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::FatArrow)) {
                parser_advance(self);
            }

            const arm_expr = self.parse_expr();
            add_child(&arm, arm_expr);
            add_child(&sw, arm);

            if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Comma)) {
                parser_advance(self);
            }
        }

        self.expect(lexer::TokenKind::RBrace);
        return sw;
    }

    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // 7. Statement Parser
    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    fn parse_body_stmt(self: *Parser) -> Node {
        if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::KwConst) or self.check(lexer::TokenKind::KwVar)) {
            return self.parse_local_decl();
        }

        if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::KwReturn)) {
            return self.parse_return_statement();
        }

        if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::KwIf)) {
            return self.parse_if_stmt();
        }

        if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::KwWhile)) {
            return self.parse_while_stmt();
        }

        if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::KwFor)) {
            return self.parse_for_stmt();
        }

        if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::KwBreak)) {
            parser_advance(self);
            if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Semicolon)) {
                parser_advance(self);
            }
            return node_new(NodeKind::StmtBreak);
        }

        if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::KwContinue)) {
            parser_advance(self);
            if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Semicolon)) {
                parser_advance(self);
            }
            return node_new(NodeKind::StmtContinue);
        }

        const expr = self.parse_expr();

        if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Equals)) {
            parser_advance(self);
            const rhs = self.parse_expr();
            if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Semicolon)) {
                parser_advance(self);
            }
            var assign = node_new(NodeKind::StmtAssign);
            add_child(&assign, expr);
            add_child(&assign, rhs);
            return assign;
        }

        if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::PlusEquals)) {
            parser_advance(self);
            const rhs = self.parse_expr();
            if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Semicolon)) {
                parser_advance(self);
            }
            var assign = node_new(NodeKind::StmtAssign);
            assign.extra_op = "+=";
            add_child(&assign, expr);
            add_child(&assign, rhs);
            return assign;
        }

        if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Semicolon)) {
            parser_advance(self);
        }
        var stmt = node_new(NodeKind::StmtExpr);
        add_child(&stmt, expr);
        return stmt;
    }

    fn parse_local_decl(self: *Parser) -> Node {
        var decl = node_new(NodeKind::StmtLocal);
        decl.extra_mutable = self.check(lexer::TokenKind::KwVar);
        parser_advance(self);

        if (self.current.kind == lexer::TokenKind::Ident or self.current.kind == lexer::TokenKind::KwModule) {
            decl.name = self.current.lexeme;
            parser_advance(self);
        }

        if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Colon)) {
            parser_advance(self);
            decl.extra_type = self.parse_type_annotation();
        }

        if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Equals)) {
            parser_advance(self);
            const init = self.parse_expr();
            add_child(&decl, init);
        }

        if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Semicolon)) {
            parser_advance(self);
        }
        return decl;
    }

    fn parse_return_statement(self: *Parser) -> Node {
        var stmt = node_new(NodeKind::ExprReturn);
        parser_advance(self);

        if (self.current.kind != lexer::TokenKind::Semicolon 
            and self.current.kind != lexer::TokenKind::RBrace) {
            const expr = self.parse_expr();
            add_child(&stmt, expr);
        }

        if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Semicolon)) {
            parser_advance(self);
        }
        return stmt;
    }

    fn parse_if_stmt(self: *Parser) -> Node {
        var if_node = node_new(NodeKind::StmtIf);
        parser_advance(self);

        self.expect(lexer::TokenKind::LParen);
        const cond = self.parse_expr();
        self.expect(lexer::TokenKind::RParen);
        add_child(&if_node, cond);

        if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::LBrace)) {
            parser_advance(self);
            var then_block = node_new(NodeKind::Module);
            then_block.name = "then";
            while (self.current.kind != lexer::TokenKind::RBrace 
                   and self.current.kind != lexer::TokenKind::Eof) {
                const s = self.parse_body_stmt();
                add_child(&then_block, s);
            }
            self.expect(lexer::TokenKind::RBrace);
            add_child(&if_node, then_block);
        } else {
            const stmt = self.parse_body_stmt();
            var then_block = node_new(NodeKind::Module);
            then_block.name = "then";
            add_child(&then_block, stmt);
            add_child(&if_node, then_block);
        }

        if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::KwElse)) {
            parser_advance(self);
            if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::KwIf)) {
                const else_if = self.parse_if_stmt();
                var else_block = node_new(NodeKind::Module);
                else_block.name = "else";
                add_child(&else_block, else_if);
                add_child(&if_node, else_block);
            } else if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::LBrace)) {
                parser_advance(self);
                var else_block = node_new(NodeKind::Module);
                else_block.name = "else";
                while (self.current.kind != lexer::TokenKind::RBrace 
                       and self.current.kind != lexer::TokenKind::Eof) {
                    const s = self.parse_body_stmt();
                    add_child(&else_block, s);
                }
                self.expect(lexer::TokenKind::RBrace);
                add_child(&if_node, else_block);
            }
        }

        return if_node;
    }

    fn parse_while_stmt(self: *Parser) -> Node {
        var while_node = node_new(NodeKind::StmtWhile);
        parser_advance(self);

        self.expect(lexer::TokenKind::LParen);
        const cond = self.parse_expr();
        self.expect(lexer::TokenKind::RParen);
        add_child(&while_node, cond);

        self.expect(lexer::TokenKind::LBrace);
        var body_block = node_new(NodeKind::Module);
        body_block.name = "body";
        while (self.current.kind != lexer::TokenKind::RBrace 
               and self.current.kind != lexer::TokenKind::Eof) {
            const s = self.parse_body_stmt();
            add_child(&body_block, s);
        }
        self.expect(lexer::TokenKind::RBrace);
        add_child(&while_node, body_block);

        return while_node;
    }

    fn parse_for_stmt(self: *Parser) -> Node {
        var for_node = node_new(NodeKind::StmtFor);
        parser_advance(self);

        self.expect(lexer::TokenKind::LParen);
        while (self.current.kind != lexer::TokenKind::RParen 
               and self.current.kind != lexer::TokenKind::Eof) {
            const iter_expr = self.parse_expr();
            add_child(&for_node, iter_expr);
            if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Comma)) {
                parser_advance(self);
            }
        }
        self.expect(lexer::TokenKind::RParen);

        if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Pipe)) {
            parser_advance(self);
            while (self.current.kind != lexer::TokenKind::Pipe 
                   and self.current.kind != lexer::TokenKind::Eof) {
                if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Star)) {
                    parser_advance(self);
                }
                if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Ident)) {
                    const param_name = self.current.lexeme;
                    parser_advance(self);
                }
                if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Comma)) {
                    parser_advance(self);
                }
            }
            self.expect(lexer::TokenKind::Pipe);
        }

        self.expect(lexer::TokenKind::LBrace);
        var body_block = node_new(NodeKind::Module);
        body_block.name = "body";
        while (self.current.kind != lexer::TokenKind::RBrace 
               and self.current.kind != lexer::TokenKind::Eof) {
            const s = self.parse_body_stmt();
            add_child(&body_block, s);
        }
        self.expect(lexer::TokenKind::RBrace);
        add_child(&for_node, body_block);

        return for_node;
    }

    fn parse_fn_body(self: *Parser) -> void {
        while (self.current.kind != lexer::TokenKind::RBrace 
               and self.current.kind != lexer::TokenKind::Eof) {
            const s = self.parse_body_stmt();
            if (s.kind != NodeKind::ExprLiteral) {
                // statement consumed
            }
        }
    }

    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // 8. Struct and Enum Body Parsers
    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    fn parse_struct_body(self: *Parser, decl: *Node) -> void {
        while (self.current.kind != lexer::TokenKind::RBrace 
               and self.current.kind != lexer::TokenKind::Eof) {
            if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Ident)) {
                const field_name = self.current.lexeme;
                parser_advance(self);

                var type_str = "";
                if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Colon)) {
                    parser_advance(self);
                    while (self.current.kind != lexer::TokenKind::Comma
                           and self.current.kind != lexer::TokenKind::Semicolon
                           and self.current.kind != lexer::TokenKind::RBrace
                           and self.current.kind != lexer::TokenKind::Eof) {
                        type_str = type_str ++ self.current.lexeme;
                        parser_advance(self);
                    }
                }

                var field = node_new(NodeKind::ExprIdentifier);
                field.name = field_name;
                field.extra_type = type_str;
                add_child(decl, field);

                if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Comma) or self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Semicolon)) {
                    parser_advance(self);
                }
            } else {
                parser_advance(self);
            }
        }
    }

    fn parse_enum_body(self: *Parser, decl: *Node) -> void {
        while (self.current.kind != lexer::TokenKind::RBrace 
               and self.current.kind != lexer::TokenKind::Eof) {
            if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Ident)) {
                const name = self.current.lexeme;
                parser_advance(self);

                var value_str = "";
                if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Equals)) {
                    parser_advance(self);
                    if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Minus)) {
                        value_str = "-";
                        parser_advance(self);
                    }
                    if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Number)) {
                        value_str = value_str ++ self.current.lexeme;
                        parser_advance(self);
                    } else if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Ident)) {
                        value_str = value_str ++ self.current.lexeme;
                        parser_advance(self);
                    }
                }

                var variant = node_new(NodeKind::ExprLiteral);
                variant.name = name;
                variant.value = value_str;
                add_child(decl, variant);

                if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Comma)) {
                    parser_advance(self);
                }
            } else {
                parser_advance(self);
            }
        }
    }

    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // 9. Top-Level Declaration Parsers
    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    fn parse_top_level_decl(self: *Parser) -> Node {
        var is_pub = false;
        if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::KwPub)) {
            is_pub = true;
            parser_advance(self);
        }

        if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::KwConst)) {
            return self.parse_const_decl(is_pub);
        }
        if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::KwVar)) {
            return self.parse_var_decl(is_pub);
        }
        if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::KwFn)) {
            return self.parse_fn_decl(is_pub);
        }
        if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::KwEnum)) {
            return self.parse_enum_decl(is_pub);
        }
        if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::KwStruct)) {
            return self.parse_struct_decl(is_pub);
        }

        return node_new(NodeKind::Module);
    }

    fn parse_const_decl(self: *Parser, is_pub: bool) -> Node {
        var decl = node_new(NodeKind::ConstDecl);
        decl.extra_pub = is_pub;

        parser_advance(self);

        if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Ident)) {
            decl.name = self.current.lexeme;
            parser_advance(self);
        }

        if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Colon)) {
            parser_advance(self);
            var type_str = "";
            if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::LBracket)) {
                type_str = "[";
                parser_advance(self);
                while (self.current.kind != lexer::TokenKind::RBracket 
                       and self.current.kind != lexer::TokenKind::Eof) {
                    type_str = type_str ++ self.current.lexeme;
                    parser_advance(self);
                }
                type_str = type_str ++ "]";
                if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::RBracket)) {
                    parser_advance(self);
                }
            }
            if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Ident)) {
                type_str = type_str ++ self.current.lexeme;
                parser_advance(self);
            }
            decl.extra_type = type_str;
        }

        if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Equals)) {
            parser_advance(self);

            if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::KwEnum)) {
                decl.kind = NodeKind::EnumDecl;
                parser_advance(self);
                if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::LParen)) {
                    parser_advance(self);
                    if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Ident)) {
                        decl.extra_type = self.current.lexeme;
                        parser_advance(self);
                    }
                    self.expect(lexer::TokenKind::RParen);
                }
                self.expect(lexer::TokenKind::LBrace);
                self.parse_enum_body(&decl);
                self.expect(lexer::TokenKind::RBrace);
            } else if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::KwStruct)) {
                decl.kind = NodeKind::StructDecl;
                parser_advance(self);
                self.expect(lexer::TokenKind::LBrace);
                self.parse_struct_body(&decl);
                self.expect(lexer::TokenKind::RBrace);
            } else if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Minus)) {
                parser_advance(self);
                if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Number)) {
                    var val_node = node_new(NodeKind::ExprLiteral);
                    val_node.value = "-" ++ self.current.lexeme;
                    add_child(&decl, val_node);
                    parser_advance(self);
                }
            } else if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Number)) {
                var val_node = node_new(NodeKind::ExprLiteral);
                val_node.value = self.current.lexeme;
                add_child(&decl, val_node);
                parser_advance(self);
            } else if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Ident)) {
                var val_node = node_new(NodeKind::ExprIdentifier);
                val_node.name = self.current.lexeme;
                add_child(&decl, val_node);
                parser_advance(self);
            } else if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::KwTrue) or self.check(lexer::TokenKind::KwFalse)) {
                var val_node = node_new(NodeKind::ExprLiteral);
                val_node.value = self.current.lexeme;
                add_child(&decl, val_node);
                parser_advance(self);
            } else if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::StringLit)) {
                var val_node = node_new(NodeKind::ExprLiteral);
                val_node.value = self.current.lexeme;
                add_child(&decl, val_node);
                parser_advance(self);
            } else {
                self.skip_to_semicolon();
                return decl;
            }

            if (self.current.kind != lexer::TokenKind::Semicolon) {
                self.skip_to_semicolon();
            }
        }

        if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Semicolon)) {
            parser_advance(self);
        }
        return decl;
    }

    fn parse_var_decl(self: *Parser, is_pub: bool) -> Node {
        var decl = node_new(NodeKind::VarDecl);
        decl.extra_pub = is_pub;

        parser_advance(self);

        if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Ident)) {
            decl.name = self.current.lexeme;
            parser_advance(self);
        }

        self.skip_to_semicolon();
        return decl;
    }

    fn parse_enum_decl(self: *Parser, is_pub: bool) -> Node {
        var decl = node_new(NodeKind::EnumDecl);
        decl.extra_pub = is_pub;

        parser_advance(self);

        if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Ident)) {
            decl.name = self.current.lexeme;
            parser_advance(self);
        }

        if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::LParen)) {
            parser_advance(self);
            while (self.current.kind != lexer::TokenKind::RParen 
                   and self.current.kind != lexer::TokenKind::Eof) {
                parser_advance(self);
            }
            self.expect(lexer::TokenKind::RParen);
        }

        self.expect(lexer::TokenKind::LBrace);
        self.skip_brace_body();
        self.expect(lexer::TokenKind::RBrace);

        return decl;
    }

    fn parse_struct_decl(self: *Parser, is_pub: bool) -> Node {
        var decl = node_new(NodeKind::StructDecl);
        decl.extra_pub = is_pub;

        parser_advance(self);

        if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Ident)) {
            decl.name = self.current.lexeme;
            parser_advance(self);
        }

        self.expect(lexer::TokenKind::LBrace);
        self.parse_struct_body(&decl);
        self.expect(lexer::TokenKind::RBrace);

        return decl;
    }

    fn parse_fn_decl(self: *Parser, is_pub: bool) -> Node {
        var decl = node_new(NodeKind::FnDecl);
        decl.extra_pub = is_pub;

        parser_advance(self);

        if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Ident)) {
            decl.name = self.current.lexeme;
            parser_advance(self);
            while (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Dot)) {
                parser_advance(self);
                if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Ident)) {
                    decl.name = decl.name ++ "." ++ self.current.lexeme;
                    parser_advance(self);
                }
            }
        }

        self.expect(lexer::TokenKind::LParen);
        while (self.current.kind != lexer::TokenKind::RParen 
               and self.current.kind != lexer::TokenKind::Eof) {
            if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Ident)) {
                const param_name = self.current.lexeme;
                parser_advance(self);
                if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Colon)) {
                    parser_advance(self);
                }
                const param_type = self.parse_type_annotation();
            }
            if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Comma)) {
                parser_advance(self);
            }
        }
        self.expect(lexer::TokenKind::RParen);

        if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Arrow)) {
            parser_advance(self);
        }

        if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Bang)) {
            parser_advance(self);
        }

        if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Ident)) {
            decl.extra_return_type = self.current.lexeme;
            parser_advance(self);
        } else if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::LBracket)) {
            var rt = "";
            while (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::LBracket)) {
                rt = rt ++ "[";
                parser_advance(self);
                while (self.current.kind != lexer::TokenKind::RBracket 
                       and self.current.kind != lexer::TokenKind::Eof) {
                    rt = rt ++ self.current.lexeme;
                    parser_advance(self);
                }
                rt = rt ++ "]";
                if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::RBracket)) {
                    parser_advance(self);
                }
            }
            if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::KwConst)) {
                rt = rt ++ "const ";
                parser_advance(self);
            }
            if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Star)) {
                rt = rt ++ "*";
                parser_advance(self);
            }
            if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Ident)) {
                rt = rt ++ self.current.lexeme;
                parser_advance(self);
            }
            decl.extra_return_type = rt;
        } else if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::KwVoid)) {
            decl.extra_return_type = "void";
            parser_advance(self);
        }

        if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::KwConst)) {
            parser_advance(self);
        }

        self.expect(lexer::TokenKind::LBrace);
        self.parse_fn_body();
        self.expect(lexer::TokenKind::RBrace);

        return decl;
    }

    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // 10. Module Parser
    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    fn parse(self: *Parser) -> Node {
        var module = node_new(NodeKind::Module);

        if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::KwModule)) {
            parser_advance(self);
            if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Ident)) {
                module.name = self.current.lexeme;
                parser_advance(self);
                while (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Minus)) {
                    module.name = module.name ++ "-";
                    parser_advance(self);
                    if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Ident) or self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Number)) {
                        module.name = module.name ++ self.current.lexeme;
                        parser_advance(self);
                    }
                }
            }
            if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Semicolon)) {
                parser_advance(self);
            } else if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::LBrace)) {
                parser_advance(self);
                self.parse_module_body(&module);
                self.expect(lexer::TokenKind::RBrace);
                return module;
            }
        }

        self.parse_module_body(&module);
        return module;
    }

    fn parse_module_body(self: *Parser, module: *Node) -> void {
        while (self.current.kind != lexer::TokenKind::Eof 
               and self.current.kind != lexer::TokenKind::RBrace) {

            if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::KwUse) or self.check(lexer::TokenKind::KwUsing)) {
                parser_advance(self);
                var full_path = "";
                var alias_name = "";
                if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Ident)) {
                    full_path = self.current.lexeme;
                    parser_advance(self);

                    if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Colon) and !self.check_peek(lexer::TokenKind::Colon)) {
                        alias_name = full_path;
                        parser_advance(self);
                        if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Ident)) {
                            parser_advance(self);
                        }
                        full_path = alias_name;
                    } else {
                        while (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Colon)) {
                            parser_advance(self);
                            if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Colon)) {
                                parser_advance(self);
                                full_path = full_path ++ "::";
                                if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Ident)) {
                                    full_path = full_path ++ self.current.lexeme;
                                    parser_advance(self);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (self.check(lexer::TokenKind::Semicolon)) {
                    parser_advance(self);
                }
                const import_name = alias_name;
                var use_node = node_new(NodeKind::UseDecl);
                use_node.name = import_name;
                use_node.value = full_path;
                add_child(module, use_node);
                continue;
            }

            const decl = self.parse_top_level_decl();
            if (decl.kind != NodeKind::Module) {
                add_child(module, decl);
            }
        }
    }

    // Precedence levels of the recursive descent chain, loosest to tightest:
    // or, and, comparison, bitor, bitxor, bitand, shift, additive, multiplicative, unary, postfix.
    const PREC_OR: u32 = 0;
    const PREC_AND: u32 = 1;
    const PREC_COMPARISON: u32 = 2;
    const PREC_BITOR: u32 = 3;
    const PREC_BITXOR: u32 = 4;
    const PREC_BITAND: u32 = 5;
    const PREC_SHIFT: u32 = 6;
    const PREC_ADDITIVE: u32 = 7;
    const PREC_MULTIPLICATIVE: u32 = 8;
    const PREC_UNARY: u32 = 9;
    const PREC_POSTFIX: u32 = 10;

    // binds_looser(a, b): true when level a binds looser than level b.
    fn binds_looser(a: u32, b: u32) -> bool {
        return a < b;
    }

    // max_children(): the child capacity of one AST node.
    fn max_children() -> u32 {
        return MAX_CHILDREN;
    }

    // kind_id(k): the numeric id of a node kind.
    fn kind_id(k: NodeKind) -> i32 {
        return @intFromEnum(k);
    }

    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    // 11. Tests
    // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

    test "kind_values" {
        assert(kind_id(NodeKind::Module) == 0);
        assert(kind_id(NodeKind::FnDecl) == 4);
        assert(kind_id(NodeKind::ExprBinary) == 22);
        assert(kind_id(NodeKind::ExprCall) == 24);
    }

    test "precedence_order" {
        assert(binds_looser(PREC_OR, PREC_AND));
        assert(binds_looser(PREC_AND, PREC_COMPARISON));
        assert(binds_looser(PREC_COMPARISON, PREC_ADDITIVE));
        assert(binds_looser(PREC_ADDITIVE, PREC_MULTIPLICATIVE));
        assert(binds_looser(PREC_MULTIPLICATIVE, PREC_UNARY));
    }

    test "max_children_constant" {
        assert(max_children() == 32);
    }

    test "node_kind_count" {
        assert(kind_id(NodeKind::ExprReturn) == 31);
        assert(kind_id(NodeKind::StmtLocal) == 10);
    }

    test "node_kind_coverage" {
        assert(kind_id(NodeKind::Module) == kind_id(NodeKind::Module));
        assert(kind_id(NodeKind::FnDecl) != kind_id(NodeKind::StructDecl));
    }

    test "expression_precedence_levels" {
        assert(binds_looser(PREC_UNARY, PREC_POSTFIX));
        assert(binds_looser(PREC_MULTIPLICATIVE, PREC_UNARY));
        assert(binds_looser(PREC_ADDITIVE, PREC_MULTIPLICATIVE));
        assert(binds_looser(PREC_SHIFT, PREC_ADDITIVE));
        assert(binds_looser(PREC_BITAND, PREC_SHIFT));
        assert(binds_looser(PREC_BITXOR, PREC_BITAND));
        assert(binds_looser(PREC_BITOR, PREC_BITXOR));
        assert(binds_looser(PREC_COMPARISON, PREC_BITOR));
        assert(binds_looser(PREC_AND, PREC_COMPARISON));
        assert(binds_looser(PREC_OR, PREC_AND));
    }

    test "break_continue_node_kinds" {
        assert(kind_id(NodeKind::StmtBreak) == 17);
        assert(kind_id(NodeKind::StmtContinue) == 18);
        assert(kind_id(NodeKind::StmtBreak) != kind_id(NodeKind::StmtContinue));
    }

    test "error_recovery_skip_to_semicolon" {
        var p = parser_from_text("fn foo() { x; }");
        assert(p.current.kind != lexer::TokenKind::Eof);
    }

    test "struct_decl_distinct_from_enum" {
        assert(kind_id(NodeKind::StructDecl) == 6);
        assert(kind_id(NodeKind::EnumDecl) == 5);
        assert(kind_id(NodeKind::StructDecl) != kind_id(NodeKind::EnumDecl));
    }

    test "all_statement_kinds_unique" {
        assert(kind_id(NodeKind::StmtLocal) != kind_id(NodeKind::StmtAssign));
        assert(kind_id(NodeKind::StmtAssign) != kind_id(NodeKind::StmtIf));
        assert(kind_id(NodeKind::StmtIf) != kind_id(NodeKind::StmtWhile));
        assert(kind_id(NodeKind::StmtWhile) != kind_id(NodeKind::StmtFor));
        assert(kind_id(NodeKind::StmtFor) != kind_id(NodeKind::StmtExpr));
        assert(kind_id(NodeKind::StmtExpr) != kind_id(NodeKind::ExprReturn));
        assert(kind_id(NodeKind::ExprReturn) != kind_id(NodeKind::StmtBreak));
        assert(kind_id(NodeKind::StmtBreak) != kind_id(NodeKind::StmtContinue));
    }
}

    1. 01 Буква, цифра или пробел
    2. 02 Где кончается слово
    3. 03 Насколько велико может быть число

    Выражение читается через 11 вложенных уровней, в готовом выражении у оператора может пропасть правая часть, а отвергнутая строка получает одну из 7 пронумерованных причин.

    1. 04 Кто связывает крепче
    2. 05 Оператор, после которого пусто
    3. 06 Семь способов отказать строке

    1. 07 Что значит имя типа
    2. 08 Кортеж для Verilog
    3. 09 if, который является значением

    1. 10 Насколько быстрый такт
    2. 11 Что он потребит
    3. 12 Провода и деревья тактов

  • Модуль 5 · Один ответ от каждого бэкенда

    Каждый случай закрепляет одну тихую ошибку компиляции: минус, потерявший скобку, общее значение, которое устарело, и байты, срезы и строки в бэкенде Rust.

    3. 15 Байты, срезы и строки

    2. 17 Метка сгенерированного файла
    3. 18 Закоммиченный вывод, который никто не пересобрал

    1. 19 Печать, проверенная посторонним

    3. 21 Прогон, оборванный посреди печати

    1. 22 Решето компиляторов
    2. 23 Семь сборок одного коммита
    3. 24 Разнообразная двойная компиляция
